session_history.summary: Seeded FIX_STATE.json with the four-fix contract (fix-01..fix-04). All fixes pending. Push-access proof commit.

fix-01 complete: audited every Gemini-driven action path and made every completion message specific (topic title + breadcrumb + entry id for filing; topic + breadcrumb + entry id for edit/delete/move). Files: callbacks.js, gemini.js, media.js, commands.js, router.js.

fixes.name: Consistent Gemini action feedback
fixes.notes: Every Gemini-driven action path now ends with a specific, plain-language confirmation naming (a) which topic (title + full breadcrumb path with › separator), (b) which entry (entry id) where applicable, and (c) what changed (filed / created + filed / moved from→to / deleted entry from topic / deleted topic + file count / updated entry). Audited: autoFileNote (text auto-file), autoFilePhoto (photo auto-file), voice explicit-path filing (media.js), voice auto-file (delegates to autoFileNote), explicit 'add this to X' free-text, explicit 'new topic X' free-text, /add pending flow (router.js), /new command (commands.js), Gemini edit (gemini.js handleEntryAction edit branch), Gemini delete_entry (D callback in callbacks.js), Gemini delete_topic (D callback in callbacks.js), move-target chosen (mt callback), newtopic pending flow (router.js). Delete-confirm prompts now include the topic breadcrumb so the operator sees exactly what will be deleted before tapping Yes. All syntax-checked with node --check.
fixes.tested: node --check on every edited file. Behavioral verification with a real message deferred to the whole-round VERIFY pass, since fix-03 adds a new home interface that also needs live testing.

fixes.name: Accept uploaded text files as note input
fixes.notes: Add a document-message handler in router.js so Telegram document uploads with text-bearing MIME/extensions (text/plain, text/markdown, text/*, application/json, application/xml, .txt, .md, .csv, .log, .json, .yaml, .yml, .xml) are treated as notes. With caption -> caption is filing hint (routed through classifyAndDispatch / autoFileNote with the caption prepended to the file body as context); without caption -> pure autoFileNote on file body. If the file's raw text is unstructured, run it through the same cleanup transformation used for voice transcripts. Fits dual manual/Gemini path model + quota rule: destination-known files (via caption 'add to X:' pattern) never call Gemini, matching the free-text explicit-path fast-path. Reuse routeFreeText / autoFileNote. Handle order-flexibility: caption-then-file is the natural single-message Telegram flow; file-first-then-follow-up-text is not supported by Telegram as a single semantic unit, so document the follow-up path as: send the file first (no caption -> it's auto-filed), then send a subsequent 'edit the note about X in Y: <instruction>' if refinement needed. Cap file size at a reasonable Worker-safe budget (256KB text) to avoid quota blowups.

fixes.name: Telegram-native home interface + Settings/Keys sub-interface, KV-backed key pool
fixes.notes: Persistent tappable home menu on /start and /menu. Sections: Browse topics, Read a topic, Export, Settings. Every screen: title line, buttons for actions, Back button, Home button. Settings sub-menu -> Gemini Keys screen. Keys stored in Cloudflare KV namespace CODEX_KV bound in wrangler.toml. Since wrangler v4 will not auto-create KV namespaces from a binding alone, add a step in .github/workflows/deploy.yml (or a small predeploy script) that (a) reads current CODEX_KV binding id from wrangler.toml, (b) if it is the placeholder 'auto', calls the Cloudflare API POST /accounts/{acct}/storage/kv/namespaces to create it, then writes the returned id back into wrangler.toml before wrangler deploy. Keys pasted newline-separated in one message. Masked list view (last 4 chars, indexed). Tap-to-remove per index + Clear All. Seed migration: on every request that reads keys, if the KV pool is empty and env.GEMINI_API_KEY is set, add that key to KV as #1 automatically (so operator keeps working without any manual re-add). Register bot command menu via setMyCommands as one-time on deploy (add a small setup step) with /start /menu /help. Update /help text to describe the tappable interface as the primary way in.
fixes.concerns: KV namespace auto-provisioning must not require operator Cloudflare-dashboard access. Two options: (A) wrangler.toml declares [[kv_namespaces]] with a preview id and let deploy step create the namespace via CF API using CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN (already in GH Actions secrets). (B) Add a tiny .github/workflows step 'ensure-kv' that idempotently creates the namespace if missing and patches wrangler.toml. Pick B — it's the most robust because wrangler v4 won't create a KV namespace at deploy from just a binding declaration.

fixes.name: Switch to gemini-flash-lite-latest + multi-key rotation with sticky last-successful key
fixes.notes: Change GEMINI_MODEL default to gemini-flash-lite-latest in wrangler.toml AND in gemini.js fallback string. Rewrite gemini() to iterate the key pool (from KV via fix-03), starting from the last-successful key index (stored in KV under key 'gemini:last_ok_idx'). Only rotate on key-specific failures: HTTP 429 (RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED), 403 (PERMISSION_DENIED/API_KEY_INVALID), 400 with API_KEY_INVALID in body. Do NOT rotate on 500/503 — retry once on same key then bubble. On success, persist new index. If every key exhausted for this request, surface a specific failure message via the fix-01 feedback style: 'Every configured Gemini key failed (N tried). Add a working key via /menu → Settings → Keys.'
